decisions: T053 extends the T033 AlpacaClient transport boundary and exposes AlpacaOptionsClient as a named option-provider facade without duplicating HTTP, retry, semaphore, or cancellation behavior.

Historical option requests use GET /v1beta1/options/trades and GET /v1beta1/options/quotes with feed=opra, comma-separated selected OSI symbols, inclusive start/end bounds, ascending sort, and cursor pagination.

Selected T024 ContractRecord values are canonicalized, de-duplicated, batched in provider-compatible groups of at most 100 symbols, and used to hydrate every returned row with OSI, underlying, expiration date, strike price, and OptionType call/put metadata.

Option trade and quote fields are normalized to UTC datetimes, exact Decimal prices, bounded integer sizes, exchange fields, and required OPRA condition codes; unselected response symbols and malformed rows fail explicitly.
limitations: All provider calls use injected asynchronous fakes; no live Alpaca/provider calls, credentials, network access, Azure provisioning, or live Azure calls were used.
Option ingestion worker, API integration, persistence wiring, and multi-year soak remain deferred to T054-T056.
No MyPy run was performed; repository tooling uses Ruff and ty.
CLEO mutations, task completion, Git staging, commits, and unrelated file changes were not performed.
